item.title: From AWS Lambda to Cloudflare Workers: free tiers and cold starts
item.description: In the previous article I described how I fitted a Telegram volleyball organizer bot into the AWS Free Tier: Lambda + S3 + EventBridge, at about zero dollars. That setup ran for months. Then I moved the same bot to Cloudflare Workers and R2 — the same Go, the same JSON state files, the same Gemini router.
